scope: Local disposable PostgreSQL only; no production application, provider requests or remote calls by this agent
runtime_changes: Existing inline option successor loop replaced by an immutable-page referenced durable admission queue
Only independently verified enumeration pages can admit new work
Existing child tasks reconcile before new admission; completed independently verified exact-window child preferred
Canonical work key uses run,Alpaca,contract symbol,start/end instants,opra,1Day; parent identity is separate lineage
New children are only unregistered contracts, grouped at most100 per request
All existing scopes, statuses, cursors, attempts, generations and running leases stay unchanged
Existing duplicate children remain executable and visible; no virtual completion or cancellation
Many-parent lineage retains each frozen parent member scope and original canonical child member scope
Canonical query_complete requires every committed page independently verified, contiguous pages and exhausted source cursor
Finalization waits for unreconciled verified enumeration admissions
No worker/provider changes or new controller required

migration_serialization.purpose: Drain pre-hook task insertions before atomic successor wiring changes

count_basis.parent_contract_links: Verified enumeration source occurrences, not distinct parent/contract pairs
count_basis.parent_work_verified_records: Entire canonical child request; not this individual contract; not additive across parent links

limitations: Pre-existing duplicate tasks deliberately still run and may make duplicate provider requests; their immutable results are deduplicated by shared delivery
Provider contract rows lacking a valid symbol or requested underlying link remain retained as explicitly counted unlinked source contracts
No global market-data completeness, historical identity or availability certificate is inferred from request completion
